test_title: PYST 46: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five people E, F, G, H and I are sitting in a straight row, facing north. There are only three people sitting to the left of H and only three people sitting to the right of F. E sits on the immediate left of F and only two people sit on the left of G. Who is sitting on the extreme right end of the row?
solution:
**Given :** Five people E, F, G, H and I are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

**Explanation : **

1) There are only three people sitting to the left of H and only three people sitting to the right of F.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8809c0e166894ca20d33e0626c61f95e519f424a1382c1b84ac09835fe169bc.png] 

2) E sits on the immediate left of F and only two people sit on the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64b6fcd4db6ad87d53f2c9df95c9906d747dfad107c7f8d4092ab8f049d0396d.png] 

**Thus, according to the final arrangement I is sitting on the extreme right end of the row.**

Hence, **"I"** is the correct answer.
